(Ava's Devices interface opens.)
If the player does not have Dizana's quiver in their inventory:
(Ava's Devices interface opens.)

steps.npc: Just a few bits of information before you run away to persecute rock crabs or cows.
Firstly, your new device won't work if you are wearing certain metallic chest armours.
The magnetic attraction required for operation would cause feedback, so the device does not allow such incompatible item equip page.
Secondly, although the device is calibrated to attract only arrow heads, there is a chance that other magnetically active items will be attracted.

The arrow recovery function of the devices is slightly different and relies upon a harmonic bond between your arrows and the chicken's magnet. You'll thus only recover arrows which you have fired rather than those
fired by nearby folks.
You'll also need to move about if you want to collect arrows since the gathering of long-lost arrowheads can't work otherwise.
Finally, the device will only work when worn. It automatically deactivates in other circumstances.
I was worried about what would happen if you were to place it in a bank in its active state, so I've made sure it only works when it's on your back.

options.text: Do you know anything about saving cannonballs?
options.condition: If the player has completed Pandemonium:

steps.text: If the player doesn't own a ballistic attractor schematic:

steps.player: Do you know anything about saving cannonballs?

steps.npc: What an oddly specific question.
As it happens the principle is much the same as the backpack we made.

steps.player: Can you explain how to make something like that for my boat?

steps.npc: Well, if we increase the flux via some bigonometry we should be able to create a dipolar ordnance grabber, or D.O.G., to fetch your balls.
Upscaling the power of your backpack device might give us the pulling power we need to create a ballistic attractor to reclaim your ammo.
I'll draw you a picture of a big magnet and you can stick it to your boat.

steps.text: Ava quickly scribbles some complicated looking schematics onto some paper for you, and then thrusts them into your hands.

steps.npc: There, that should do what you need.

steps.text: If the player already owns a ballistic attractor schematic or has read it:

steps.player: Do you know anything about saving cannonballs?

steps.npc: Yes, and now you also know it!

options.text: I'll just head off, I think.

steps.player: I'll just head off, I think.

steps.npc: Thanks for the help with my bed; see you again.

steps.npc: Hmm...
That truly is a remarkable piece of equipment.
Bring me one of my devices. I might be able to link the two!

steps.player: Wow! Really? I better go and grab one.

steps.npc: If you've got the materials, I can make one now for you?

using-dizana-s-quiver-or-blessed-dizana-.text: If the player has one of Ava's devices or a Ranging cape in their inventory:

steps.npc: Let me see...
Extraordinary...
That quiver has some of the finest leatherwork I've ever seen!

steps.player: I was wondering if you could maybe make it... better?

steps.npc: Better? Let me see... I might be able to do something.
I'll see if I can link it to the device you have with you.

steps.text: Ava takes the quiver and fiddles around with it for a bit...

steps.npc: Ouch!
That's some tough material...
Move that here...
There we go! That's some of my finest work, if I do say so myself.
